title: aerangis stylosa
intro: Aerangis stylosa, commonly known as the 'Tiger Orchid', is a species of orchid native to tropical regions of Africa. This plant is known for its vibrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aerangis stylosa include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its use as an antiseptic and antifungal agent. The bioactive constituents of Aerangis stylosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
